items.html: No deferred process gates — long-running / non-blocking execution via WAITING(gate_pending) + GATE_RESULT (pending-envelope stash, replay/idempotency, timeout-recovery, cancel-cleanup, runner-retry) is a later lifecycle slice, named but not numbered → later
No projection_ref + scoped-query SDK — the process gets a compact inline projection; an authority-scoped query seam replaces it later → later / L7-ish

No fail_instance disposition — a runner error can only block_transition in the MVP; configuring fail_instance is rejected (gate_config_not_supported) until terminal-failure ownership + operator recovery are modeled → later
No route verdict — a gate still cannot redirect the target (meta-review auto-rework, human gate) → routing slice / L3
No actor-facing trust / skip-rerun communication — missing vs explicit-null trust level is not surfaced to the reviewer yet → L2b
No dynamic module loading — the external process interface is the extension seam; no in-process plugin loader in the MVP → later
